question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Melody
solution:
The correct answer is '**Disharmony**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Melody **refers to a sequence of pleasing musical notes that form a coherent whole, creating a memorable and enjoyable tune. (मधुर संगीत)

 
 
• **Example**: The **melody **of her favorite song always brought a smile to her face.
 
 
 
• **Disharmony **signifies a lack of harmony, concord, or agreement; it refers to when musical notes sound in conflict with each other instead of forming a pleasant whole. (विषमता)
 
 
• **Example**: The musicians struggled to play together, resulting in **disharmony **that was unpleasant to the listeners.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **Disharmony**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Musicality **(संगीतात्मकता) refers to the quality of having a pleasant sound; it is about being musical or having the qualities of music itself.
 
• **Symphony **(सहवादन) is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and performed by an orchestra.
 
• **Ballad **(गीतिकाव्य) is a type of song or poem that narrates a story in short stanzas.
